title: Moisture content.
officialText:
Fire-retardant-treated wood shall be dried to a moisture content of 19 percent or less for
lumber and 15 percent or less for wood structural panels before use. For wood kiln dried after treatment
(KDAT), the kiln temperatures shall not exceed those used in kiln drying the lumber and plywood submitted
for the tests described in Section 2303.2.5.1 for plywood and 2303.2.5.2 for lumber.
